dtype_policy.note: is_approximation=true means the lab runs the model in a narrower dtype than the checkpoint stores (Halo: float32 store, bfloat16 run, per SPEC.md 4). All Phase 1 weight distances are computed from the stored bytes in float64 and are unaffected.
